COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

   A. Treat Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action .
   C. Explain Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Support Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Support Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Support Systems as rumours only.
   C. Say Support Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Support Systems.

4. Which statement about Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

7. Which statement about Building Resilience is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Building Resilience.
   B. Explain Building Resilience with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Building Resilience as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Leadership Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
